jobs.title: Geologist (Flex Staff)
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Check out this video and find out why our team loves to work here!

Join Us! CDM Smith – where amazing career journeys unfold.

Imagine a place committed to offering an unmatched employee experience. Where you work on projects that are meaningful to you. Where you play an active part in shaping your career journey. Where your co-workers are invested in you and your success. Where you are encouraged and supported to do your very best and given the tools and resources to do so. Where it’s a priority that the company takes good care of you and your family.

Our employees are the heart of our company. As an employer of choice, our goal is to provide a challenging, progressive and inclusive work environment which fosters personal leadership, career growth and development for every employee. We value passionate individuals who challenge the norm, deliver world-class solutions and bring diverse perspectives. Join our team, and together we will make a difference and change the world.

Job Description

Job Duties:

Plan and conduct geologic and environmental investigations
Conduct drilling and logging for moderate to highly complex projects
Log soil/rock cores and prepare boring logs per ASTM/USCS standards
Collect and manage environmental and geotechnical samples for laboratory analysis
Install and maintain groundwater monitoring wells/instrumentation
Prepare technical field notes, logs, and support documentation.
Attend progress meetings.
Perform other duties as assigned.
This is a pipeline requisition for future project hires.

Skills & Abilities

Must be a U.S. citizen.
Able to pass a federal background check.
Able to pass a medical examination.
Ability to work in the field which can include long periods of standing, walking or sitting.
Proficient in soil/rock logging, boring logs, and well installations.
Knowledge of OSHA/HAZWOPER and environmental standards.
Strong technical writing, problem-solving, and GIS/software skills.
Ability to manage multiple tasks.
Federal project experience is highly desirable.
Strong organizational skills to balance and prioritize work.
Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality assurance.
Strong writing and oral communication skills to work with military clients, contractors, and government teams.
Good interpersonal skills to cultivate relationships with colleagues, customers, and partners.
Ability to work independently in field settings under limited supervision.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree.
5 years of relevant experience.

Equivalent additional directly related experience will be considered in lieu of a college degree.

Domestic and/or international travel may be required. The frequency of travel is contingent on specific duties, responsibilities, and the essential functions of the position, which may vary depending on workload and project demands.

Preferred Qualifications

PG (Professional Geologist) License.
Knowledge of Unified Soil Classification System for logging soils.
40-hour OSHA Hazwoper certification with 8-hour annual refresher training which is up to date.
8-hour supervisory training.
30-hour OSHA Construction Industry safety class.
Current CPR/FA/AED certification.

Amount Of Travel Required

100%

Driving Requirements

An appropriate and valid driver's license is required.

EEO Statement

We attract the best people in the industry, supporting their efforts to learn and grow. We strive to create a challenging and progressive work environment. We provide career opportunities that span a variety of disciplines and geographic locations, with projects that our employees plan, design, build and operate as diverse as the needs of our clients. CDM Smith Inc. and its divisions and subsidiaries are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, pregnancy related conditions, childbirth and related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression), national origin, age, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Evergreen Disclaimer

Please note, this is a pipeline position for future needs and is not an immediate vacancy.

Background Check and Drug Testing Information

CDM Smith Inc. and its divisions and subsidiaries (hereafter collectively referred to as “CDM Smith”) reserves the right to require background checks including criminal, employment, education, licensure, etc. as well as credit and motor vehicle when applicable for certain positions. In addition, CDM Smith may conduct drug testing for designated positions. Background checks are conducted after an offer of employment has been made in the United States. The timing of when background checks will be conducted on candidates for positions outside the United States will vary based on country statutory law but in no case, will the background check precede an interview. CDM Smith will conduct interviews of qualified individuals prior to requesting a criminal background check, and no job application submitted prior to such interview shall inquire into an applicant's criminal history. If this position is subject to a background check for any convictions related to its responsibilities and requirements, employment will be contingent upon successful completion of a background investigation including criminal history. Criminal history will not automatically disqualify a candidate. In addition, during employment individuals may be required by CDM Smith or a CDM Smith client to successfully complete additional background checks, including motor vehicle record as well as drug testing.

Massachusetts Applicants

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Additional Pay Range Information

CDM Smith is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. This pay range is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels for the geographic location assigned to the position. In addition to geographic location, a candidate’s salary is determined by several other factors including, but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, relevant work experience, skills, required certifications, and education/training.

Additional Compensation

All bonuses at CDM Smith are discretionary and may or may not apply to this position.

Visa Sponsorship Available

jobs.title: Data Analyst III - Data Analytics & Reporting - 100% remote
jobs.description:
1. About Our Client:
The organization operates within the health and human services sector, focusing on connecting individuals to essential services. It addresses challenges related to delivering reliable analytics and reporting solutions to improve program effectiveness and business outcomes for a large population.

2. About the Opportunity:
The Data Analyst III - Data Analytics & Reporting role is responsible for delivering complex data analysis and reporting that supports decision-making and operational improvements. This position provides clear, actionable insights to diverse stakeholders, contributing to the effectiveness of programs and compliance efforts. The role impacts how the organization uses data to enhance service delivery and business processes.

3. Responsibilities:
• Conduct complex data extraction, transformation, validation, and analysis using large datasets.
• Develop SQL scripts, stored procedures, and analytical processes to support reporting and data visualization.
• Perform statistical analyses and trend evaluations to inform decisions.
• Create and maintain datasets, reports, and summaries for monitoring and compliance.
• Utilize enterprise data platforms and analytical tools including SQL Server, Oracle, Snowflake, IBM SPSS, Python, Excel, and SSRS.
• Respond to data requests from leadership, business partners, and program staff.
• Provide technical assistance on data and analytical methodologies.
• Collaborate to define requirements and deliver analytical solutions.
• Initiate and conduct analytical projects supporting policy evaluation and operational improvements.
• Analyze public-sector data sources to identify trends and evaluate program outcomes.
• Develop structured datasets and documentation for analytical initiatives.
• Communicate findings and recommendations through reports, presentations, and data visualizations.

4. Requirements:
• Experience performing complex data analysis under minimal supervision.
• Ability to develop SQL scripts and use analytical tools such as Python, IBM SPSS, and reporting services.
• Skilled in statistical analysis and data visualization.
• Experience collaborating with business partners and communicating technical information to non-technical audiences.
• Proven ability to conduct analytical projects and apply data to improve operational outcomes.

• Salary range: $4,801.16 to $6,281.33 monthly.

• Opportunities for career advancement.

jobs.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

1. About Our Client:

The organization operates in the healthcare technology sector, focusing on improving the health and well-being of vulnerable populations through data-driven solutions. It supports state Medicaid agencies, Fee-For-Service providers, and managed care organizations by delivering accurate healthcare quality measures. The organization emphasizes career growth, work flexibility, and skill development, reflecting its commitment to employees and its impact on Medicaid quality reporting at scale.

2. About the Opportunity:

The Experienced Data Analyst
– Medicaid Quality for the Patient Centered Medical Home (PCMH) program is responsible for designing and maintaining healthcare quality measures used in Medicaid reporting. This role ensures the accuracy and methodological integrity of quality metrics, translating complex specifications into actionable insights. The position is crucial for supporting regulatory compliance and improving Medicaid quality reporting through data analysis and clear communication with stakeholders.

3. Responsibilities:

Design, compute, validate, and explain healthcare quality measures for Medicaid programs
Serve as a subject-matter expert on PCMH measures and Medicaid data domains
Implement and maintain measure logic according to annual updates
Ensure data quality and methodological integrity in reporting
Support internal reviews, client reporting, and audit inquiries
Communicate measure methodology, assumptions, and results to clinical and leadership teams
Utilize advanced SQL to analyze large Medicaid datasets
Develop and execute data transformations for analytics-ready datasets
Use Python or equivalent tools for analysis, validation, and automation
Maintain version-controlled documentation of measure logic

4. Requirements:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Healthcare Informatics, Biostatistics, MIS, Statistics, or related field
Minimum 10 years of experience in healthcare reporting, BI, analytics, data warehousing, or medical billing
Subject-matter expertise in Medicaid/Medicare, payers, providers, or health services
Strong skills in SQL, Oracle, ETL, data warehousing infrastructure, and reporting tools like Business Objects
Proficient in software development lifecycle methodologies
Excellent written and verbal communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills

5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:

The pay range for this position is $81,100.00 to $115,900.00 per year, with variation based on geographic region, internal equity, knowledge, skills, and experience
Eligible for a 401(k) employer match
Comprehensive health benefits
Educational assistance

401(k) employer match
Comprehensive health benefits
Educational assistance

jobs.description:

401(k)

HETI has a great opportunity for a Senior Geologist/Senior Environmental Scientist/Senior Engineer with 10+ years’ experience in the environmental field.

This role will be responsible for providing technical and business skills and contribute to advanced solutions in the environmental, chemical, commercial, manufacturing, government, energy, financial, insurance, and/or legal sectors. This job is 100% remote.

The candidate should have experience managing consulting assignments, must work effectively in multi-disciplinary teams, is expected to be proficient in the analysis and communication of information, and must be able to work cooperatively with agencies, organizations, and individuals to guide decision-making. The successful candidate is also expected to be proficient in all facets of project management. He/she must demonstrate collaboration with colleagues throughout the organization.

Key Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Client Management & Communication:

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status and outcomes.
Collaborate with project teams, including environmental engineers, geologists, and technicians.
Communicate complex technical information to clients and stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.

Regulatory Compliance & Reporting:

Interact and coordinate with regulatory agencies to obtain necessary approvals, permits, and closure documentation.
Prepare and submit comprehensive reports, including site investigation reports, risk assessment reports, remedial action plans, progress reports, and closure reports.
Be current and continue to be current on environmental regulations and guidelines.

Remediation Planning/Implementation:

Develop and implement effective remediation plans based on the findings of site investigations and risk assessments.
Design and oversee the implementation of remediation strategies, which may include excavation, soil vapor extraction, groundwater treatment, in-situ bioremediation, or other appropriate methods.
Ensure compliance with all applicable regulations, guidelines, and permits during the remediation process.

Insurance Claim Support

Experience providing technical support to insurance claims professionals for environmental or energy related claims.
Understanding of insurance terminology and policy language.
Experience in assessing the source and timing of pollution events.
Diverse environmental consulting experience.
Excellent technical writing skills.

Site Assessments:

Manage/conduct comprehensive site investigations to identify potential sources of contamination, evaluate risks, and develop appropriate remediation strategies.
Collect soil, groundwater, and other environmental samples and analyze them in accordance with standard protocols and regulations.
Perform data interpretation, risk assessment, and modeling to determine the extent and nature of contamination and its potential impact on human health and the environment.

Quality Control:

Implement quality control and assurance measures to ensure accurate and reliable data collection, analysis, and reporting.
Conduct periodic audits and reviews of project activities to verify compliance with project plans and regulations.
Identify and address any deviations or discrepancies in project execution promptly.

The Ideal Candidate should have:

Current PE or PG license
Bachelor’s Degree in environmental science, geology, engineering, or a related field.
10+ years’ experience conducting site investigations remediation and third party evaluations
Solid understanding of environmental regulations, guidelines, and best practices related to contaminated site cleanup.
Excellent project management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, regulatory agencies, and project teams.
Attention to detail, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
Knowledge of environmental sampling techniques and laboratory analysis methods.

Founded in 1986, HETI is a full-service, nationwide environmental services company specializing in environmental and indoor air quality site assessment, site remediation, risk characterization, occupational health and safety services, and litigation/expert witness support. Through our network of offices throughout the U.S., we serve a variety of large and small businesses.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and offer a competitive benefit package including base salary plus bonus opportunities and a friendly, flexible work environment.

Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.description:
Project Coordinator | Capital Markets & Business Operations | Remote Independent Contractor

Executive Agility is seeking expressions of interest from an experienced
Project Coordinator
to join our growing team. This remote, part-time independent-contractor engagement, is an execution & project coordination role with administrative, communication & delivery responsibilities across multiple concurrent projects. You can work from anywhere within the United States. We are not accepting applications from overseas candidates.

The role combines project coordination, administration, client service, document control, communications & digital operations. The successful contractor must be highly organized, detail-driven, AI-literate & comfortable working with senior executives, boards, auditors, lawyers, bankers, contractors & clients.

🔷 WHO WE ARE

Executive Agility is the listing readiness quarterback for U.S. capital markets. We help companies prepare for & execute domestic IPOs, up-listings, dual listings, cross-border listings, SPACs & de-SPACs.

We solve two problems: execution readiness & execution coordination.

We diagnose the gaps, build the roadmap, execute governance, PCAOB audit & disclosure-readiness workstreams, deploy interim or fractional executives, place independent board directors & coordinate the critical path across counsel, auditors, bankers, boards & management.

Our role is to keep every workstream moving concurrently, not sequentially, so companies accelerate schedule, reduce costs & reduce execution risk.

🔷 THE ROLE

The Project Coordinator will:
✔ Manage project schedules, milestones & execution timelines
✔ Build & maintain Gantt charts, scorecards, trackers & KPI templates
✔ Track actions, risks, issues, decisions & deliverables in structured registers
✔ Coordinate information requests across clients, advisors, contractors & stakeholders
✔ Prepare concise status reports to keep leadership & clients informed
✔ Schedule & coordinate meetings, agendas, minutes, decisions & follow-up actions
✔ Maintain document control, version control & structured filing environments
✔ Coordinate Virtual Data Room setup, uploads, permissions & indexing
✔ Monitor designated inboxes, route emails & track client requests
✔ Handle client enquiries, scheduling, correspondence & follow-ups
✔ Coordinate contractor & candidate administration, records, onboarding documentation, agreements, SOWs & digital execution
✔ Maintain CRM, contact, contractor, candidate & project records
✔ Assist with proposals, presentations, reports, templates & routine business correspondence
✔ Coordinate social-media posting, content scheduling, website updates, outreach & email campaigns
✔ Use AI productivity tools to improve research, drafting, reporting, meeting documentation & workflow efficiency
✔ Identify delays, missing information & unresolved actions and escalate them promptly
✔ Ensure follow-through across assigned workstreams with minimal supervision.

🔷 ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE

✔ Prior experience in project coordination, PMO support, project management.
✔ Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams & deadlines
✔ Experience maintaining schedules, Gantt charts, trackers, registers & reports
✔ Strong administration capability, including inboxes, scheduling, records, communications & follow-up
✔ Strong written communication, client-service & reporting skills
✔ High discipline in document control, version control & information management
✔ Competence with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, SharePoint & Excel
✔ Practical AI literacy and experience using generative-AI tools in business workflows
✔ Ability to work remotely, prioritize independently & deliver agreed outcomes
✔ Sound judgement, confidentiality, accuracy & attention to detail.

🔷 HIGH-VALUE EXPERIENCE / QUALIFICATIONS

✔ CAPM, PMP, PRINCE2, Certified Practising Project Practitioner or equivalent qualification
✔ Diploma of Project Management or similar qualification accompanied by practical project-management experience
✔ Capital-markets, IPO, governance, executive-search, legal, audit, finance, consulting or advisory experience
✔ Virtual Data Room or due-diligence coordination experience
✔ Experience supporting senior executives, boards or multi-advisor projects
✔ Experience with CRM, social media, website, email-campaign or contractor-administration workflows.

HETI has a great opportunity for a Senior Geologist/Senior Environmental Scientist/Senior Engineer with 10+ years’ experience in the environmental field.

This role will be responsible for providing technical and business skills and contribute to advanced solutions in the environmental, chemical, commercial, manufacturing, government, energy, financial, insurance, and/or legal sectors. This job is 100% remote.

The candidate should have experience managing consulting assignments, must work effectively in multi-disciplinary teams, is expected to be proficient in the analysis and communication of information, and must be able to work cooperatively with agencies, organizations, and individuals to guide decision-making. The successful candidate is also expected to be proficient in all facets of project management. He/she must demonstrate collaboration with colleagues throughout the organization.

Key Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Client Management & Communication:

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status and outcomes.
Collaborate with project teams, including environmental engineers, geologists, and technicians.
Communicate complex technical information to clients and stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.

Regulatory Compliance & Reporting:

Interact and coordinate with regulatory agencies to obtain necessary approvals, permits, and closure documentation.
Prepare and submit comprehensive reports, including site investigation reports, risk assessment reports, remedial action plans, progress reports, and closure reports.
Be current and continue to be current on environmental regulations and guidelines.

Remediation Planning/Implementation:

Develop and implement effective remediation plans based on the findings of site investigations and risk assessments.
Design and oversee the implementation of remediation strategies, which may include excavation, soil vapor extraction, groundwater treatment, in-situ bioremediation, or other appropriate methods.
Ensure compliance with all applicable regulations, guidelines, and permits during the remediation process.

Insurance Claim Support

Experience providing technical support to insurance claims professionals for environmental or energy related claims.
Understanding of insurance terminology and policy language.
Experience in assessing the source and timing of pollution events.
Diverse environmental consulting experience.
Excellent technical writing skills.

Site Assessments:

Manage/conduct comprehensive site investigations to identify potential sources of contamination, evaluate risks, and develop appropriate remediation strategies.
Collect soil, groundwater, and other environmental samples and analyze them in accordance with standard protocols and regulations.
Perform data interpretation, risk assessment, and modeling to determine the extent and nature of contamination and its potential impact on human health and the environment.

Quality Control:

Implement quality control and assurance measures to ensure accurate and reliable data collection, analysis, and reporting.
Conduct periodic audits and reviews of project activities to verify compliance with project plans and regulations.
Identify and address any deviations or discrepancies in project execution promptly.

The Ideal Candidate should have:

Current PE or PG license
Bachelor’s Degree in environmental science, geology, engineering, or a related field.
10+ years’ experience conducting site investigations remediation and third party evaluations
Solid understanding of environmental regulations, guidelines, and best practices related to contaminated site cleanup.
Excellent project management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, regulatory agencies, and project teams.
Attention to detail, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
Knowledge of environmental sampling techniques and laboratory analysis methods.

Founded in 1986, HETI is a full-service, nationwide environmental services company specializing in environmental and indoor air quality site assessment, site remediation, risk characterization, occupational health and safety services, and litigation/expert witness support. Through our network of offices throughout the U.S., we serve a variety of large and small businesses.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and offer a competitive benefit package including base salary plus bonus opportunities and a friendly, flexible work environment.

Flexible work from home options available.

Project Coordinator | Capital Markets & Business Operations | Remote Independent Contractor

Executive Agility is seeking expressions of interest from an experienced
Project Coordinator
to join our growing team. This remote, part-time independent-contractor engagement, is an execution & project coordination role with administrative, communication & delivery responsibilities across multiple concurrent projects. You can work from anywhere within the United States. We are not accepting applications from overseas candidates.

The role combines project coordination, administration, client service, document control, communications & digital operations. The successful contractor must be highly organized, detail-driven, AI-literate & comfortable working with senior executives, boards, auditors, lawyers, bankers, contractors & clients.

🔷 WHO WE ARE

Executive Agility is the listing readiness quarterback for U.S. capital markets. We help companies prepare for & execute domestic IPOs, up-listings, dual listings, cross-border listings, SPACs & de-SPACs.

We solve two problems: execution readiness & execution coordination.

We diagnose the gaps, build the roadmap, execute governance, PCAOB audit & disclosure-readiness workstreams, deploy interim or fractional executives, place independent board directors & coordinate the critical path across counsel, auditors, bankers, boards & management.

Our role is to keep every workstream moving concurrently, not sequentially, so companies accelerate schedule, reduce costs & reduce execution risk.

🔷 THE ROLE

The Project Coordinator will:
✔ Manage project schedules, milestones & execution timelines
✔ Build & maintain Gantt charts, scorecards, trackers & KPI templates
✔ Track actions, risks, issues, decisions & deliverables in structured registers
✔ Coordinate information requests across clients, advisors, contractors & stakeholders
✔ Prepare concise status reports to keep leadership & clients informed
✔ Schedule & coordinate meetings, agendas, minutes, decisions & follow-up actions
✔ Maintain document control, version control & structured filing environments
✔ Coordinate Virtual Data Room setup, uploads, permissions & indexing
✔ Monitor designated inboxes, route emails & track client requests
✔ Handle client enquiries, scheduling, correspondence & follow-ups
✔ Coordinate contractor & candidate administration, records, onboarding documentation, agreements, SOWs & digital execution
✔ Maintain CRM, contact, contractor, candidate & project records
✔ Assist with proposals, presentations, reports, templates & routine business correspondence
✔ Coordinate social-media posting, content scheduling, website updates, outreach & email campaigns
✔ Use AI productivity tools to improve research, drafting, reporting, meeting documentation & workflow efficiency
✔ Identify delays, missing information & unresolved actions and escalate them promptly
✔ Ensure follow-through across assigned workstreams with minimal supervision.

🔷 ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE

✔ Prior experience in project coordination, PMO support, project management.
✔ Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams & deadlines
✔ Experience maintaining schedules, Gantt charts, trackers, registers & reports
✔ Strong administration capability, including inboxes, scheduling, records, communications & follow-up
✔ Strong written communication, client-service & reporting skills
✔ High discipline in document control, version control & information management
✔ Competence with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, SharePoint & Excel
✔ Practical AI literacy and experience using generative-AI tools in business workflows
✔ Ability to work remotely, prioritize independently & deliver agreed outcomes
✔ Sound judgement, confidentiality, accuracy & attention to detail.

🔷 HIGH-VALUE EXPERIENCE / QUALIFICATIONS

✔ CAPM, PMP, PRINCE2, Certified Practising Project Practitioner or equivalent qualification
✔ Diploma of Project Management or similar qualification accompanied by practical project-management experience
✔ Capital-markets, IPO, governance, executive-search, legal, audit, finance, consulting or advisory experience
✔ Virtual Data Room or due-diligence coordination experience
✔ Experience supporting senior executives, boards or multi-advisor projects
✔ Experience with CRM, social media, website, email-campaign or contractor-administration workflows.

Practical project-management experience & portfolio evidence will be required.

🔷 YOUR PROFILE

✔ You create structure, visibility & accountability across complex work
✔ You are comfortable combining project coordination with detailed administration & client service
✔ You communicate professionally with executives, clients, advisors & contractors
✔ You can independently manage routine activities while escalating material issues promptly
✔ You can demonstrate schedules, Gantt charts, registers, dashboards, reports or workflows you have created
✔ You are dependable, responsive & able to keep multiple priorities moving without constant supervision.

✔ Remote, part-time independent-contractor engagement
✔ Variable hours based on client & business requirements

Apply via LinkedIn with a current CV. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted directly by Executive Agility for a confidential conversation.

Approaches from recruitment agencies will not be responded to.
